title: Minkowski, Hecke, Landau, Sylvester, and Other Classical Mathematics Authors: Modern LaTeX Drafts
version: 2026-06-02 author cluster refresh: Sylvester Volume I source-checked through book page 118
description:
Linked author-cluster record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Public-Domain Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record presents reader-facing modern LaTeX drafts for selected works by Minkowski, Hecke, Landau, Steinitz, Hensel, Oka, Hausdorff, Grassmann, Killing, and the active Sylvester Volume I source-checked working edition.

Coverage at this release:

  • Reader PDFs: [##########] 13/13 public reader PDFs staged by author/work, including Sylvester Volume I through book page 118. The Landau reader is the English Goodman translation with publisher/translator front matter removed and mathematical text retained.
  • Sylvester source-checked lane: [####------] Volume I is source-checked in TeX/PDF through book page 118, with direct segment readers for book pages 76-90 and 91-118. Collected-papers source scans for Volumes I and IV remain preserved in the artifact/source layer.
  • Front-matter review: [########--] obvious modern collected-volume title/copyright/editorial pages removed from the public PDFs; source/provenance packets remain available for checking.
  • Source/provenance artifacts: [##########] source packets, TeX, component PDFs, source scans, and provenance reports preserved in the artifact/source layer.
  • Proofreading state: [###-------] machine-assisted working drafts; not proofed critical editions.

Public organization is by author and work. Source scans and provenance material are preserved in ZIP artifacts so the top-level PDF list stays focused on reader-facing compiled drafts.
notes: Current public-facing author-cluster record, organized by author and work. Latest update adds the Sylvester Volume I source-checked working edition through book page 118, with source TeX and scan witnesses in the GitHub mirror.
